generationInputs.prompt: A digitally drawn illustration in a clean, graphic, and expressive modern emoji style on a white background with minimal, cartoonish shading using slightly darker versions of the base colors and simple white highlights shows a worried yellow emoji with bold black outlines and flat, vibrant color fills. The emoji has a round head with two large, expressive brown eyes with white highlights and black pupils looking slightly upward and thick, curved black eyebrows tilted inwards. A hand with a slightly lighter yellow skin tone, defined by bold black outlines and flat color, covers the area where the emoji's mouth would be. The fingers of the hand are bent, with the index finger and thumb appearing to pinch. The emoji has a small, rounded body with two muscular arms ending in clenched fists. The left arm is bent at the elbow and held close to the body, while the right arm is slightly more extended. Below the torso are two muscular legs with clenched fists for feet. A flat black garment, resembling underwear bottoms with bold black outlines, is worn low on the emoji's body. There is subtle shading suggesting a surface below the emoji.
